sections.brief: Hook: vibe checks don't scale. Frame 0 is the thumbnail: the on-screen headline 'Vibe checks don't scale' (h2, top band, words-in pre-rolled so it reads at t=0) is up at 0. It carries the story muted, so it stays up. The page of example traces rises in at cue:measure (rows staggered, the mark circles draw on). cue:better: a green tick (local, `pass`) draws into row 2's mark. cue:breaks: as row 2 stays green, row 4's mark turns into a red cross (`fail`), then row 2's tick wobbles away: fixing one breaks another. End on key s1 (page visible, marks empty again) and clear the locals.

Level 1, unit tests. Headline (local, h2, top band, words-in at the section start): 'Level 1 · unit tests'. At cue:three, a small row of three numbered dots (1 · 2 · 3, local, under the headline) pops in, the first one green. cue:unit: an assertion card (local, dark ink fill, mono white text `assert no_raw_ids(reply)`) rises in between the headline and the page. cue:every: green ticks draw into every row's mark in turn, top to bottom (stagger ~0.12 s), except row 3. cue:ids: row 3 gets a red cross and a short red mono tag `a3f9-…` beside its text (the leaked id), with a highlight. Hold, breathe the page. Clear the locals at the end (page stays: key s2 = as s1).

Level 2, people and a judge. Headline (local, h2, two lines OK, top band): 'Level 2 · people + a judge'. cue:traces: the rows' text dims to muted and back (they are logged traces). cue:review: a small column label 'you' (local, label) appears above a column of marks just left of the shared marks; cue:good: hand marks land in it row by row: good (green filled dot) for rows 1, 2, 4; bad (red) for rows 3, 5. cue:judge: a second column label 'judge' over the shared mark circles, and the judge's marks fill them all at once (one pass): green 1, 2; red 3, 4, 5. cue:agrees: rows where both agree get a soft green highlight; row 4, where they disagree, gets a red outline (draw-on) and a small 'disagree' label: that's what you check. Clear the locals by the end so the shared marks are empty and key s3 = as s1.

A viewer for your own data, as a short walkthrough (docs/motion.md §7: focus, spotlight, chip). Headline (local, h2, top band, layer above the spotlight, e.g. 960): 'Build a viewer\nfor your data'. cue:viewer: a viewer panel (local, ui: true, white card, line stroke) rises in over the lower part of the page with: a label 'scenario' and value 'listing search · synthetic', a label 'output' and two or three mono lines of a reply, and two buttons 'Good' (pass green) and 'Bad' (fail red). A small grey 'Concept mock' label at the panel's bottom right. The camera `focus`es onto the panel (on the panel, ~1.6×, ease arrive), a `spotlight` on the panel dims the rest. cue:scenario then cue:output: the spotlight glides from the scenario field to the output lines (move + to w/h, ~0.6 s each; they are close). cue:click: a chip 'one click to label' (≤ 6 words, beside the Good button, on a leader to it, never over it) appears and the Good button pulses once (an eased press, no bounce). Hold. Before the section ends: camera focus back to full (ease glide), spotlight off, clear the locals; page as key s3.

Level 3, then the lesson (last section). Headline (local, h2, top band): 'Level 3 · A/B tests' at cue:ab, with two small labelled bars 'A' and 'B' (local, no numbers) growing side by side under it, B a little longer, over the page. cue:look: everything clears (page and all) and the end card lands: big text 'Look at your data.' (h1 or stat-ish size, two lines OK, ink) with a big green hand tick drawn on beside it, then at cue:end a muted line 'That is how you move fast.' and a small grey credit at the bottom of the safe area (above the feed's bottom ~240 px): 'From “Your AI Product Needs Evals” · Hamel Husain, 2024'. All beats finish by ~46.5 s; the end card holds to the end, breathing gently.
